out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: Salmon can be ordered undercooked (Caesar salad, pescado adovado), and was listen on the menu without an asterisk.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. Please update the menu to have an asterisk at the two salmon dishes that can be ordered undercooked. E-mail a copy of the corrected menu to the inspector within 10 days.
